actual_request.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original complete production movement sprite for 10_crimson_spear_girl, slot N02. Single square native frame at least 1024x1024, genuinely transparent alpha. No sheet, duplicate body, label, UI, checkerboard, floor, shadow, colored matte or effects. Input Image1 is authoritative identity: faithfully retain brown double buns and long twin tails, red ribbons, ornate gold and pale turquoise hair ornaments, amber eyes when visible, red/gold forehead jewel when visible, red/ivory/gold layered costume, gold trim and waist beads, red-white-gold boots, and exactly the same long dark shaft spear with ornate crimson crystal blade, gold guard and red tassels. Image2 is the confirmed MAIN STYLE: clean bright rounded Daoist chibi hand-painted materials, delicate warm shading, crisp finished edges. Do not copy its UI, portraits or alter this character colors. Image3 is the front-action scale and weapon construction reference, not this new view: preserve its chibi head/body proportions, outfit details, gear scale and consistent two-hand grip, then draw the correct new view and specified leg phase. Image4 fixes the same-direction camera, silhouette size, costume back construction and spear orientation; genuinely redraw the requested different leg phase, do not reproduce its pose. Facing NORTH directly away from viewer, exact straight rear view. Show back of head, both buns and back costume; NO face or eyes. Anatomical LEFT is screen LEFT, RIGHT is screen RIGHT. Forward points screen UP into distance: forward boot is farther away and slightly higher on the canvas than the trailing boot. Keep fixed slightly elevated game camera, no camera roll, same rounded short-limb proportion as Image3. Center grounded body around x512, contact-root around y942 on a 1024 canvas (scale fractions if native resolution differs). Entire head, twin tails, red ribbons, wide sleeves, spear tip, spear butt and both boots inside canvas with margin; match Image3 relative subject scale. Her anatomical LEFT hand always grips higher on the shaft nearer the blade at chest level; anatomical RIGHT hand grips lower near waist. This order is fixed in character coordinates as the view turns, not fixed screen sides. One single straight unbroken dark shaft through both hands. Rear-view arms and shaft can naturally occlude behind the torso; do not put a second weapon on her back. In straight N, blade projects toward screen upper-left and butt toward screen lower-right, opposite the front reference screen projection. WALK PHASE 02 of 16 (one complete alternating left-right cycle, 30ms per frame): Anatomical LEFT forward boot has just flattened on the ground and left knee softly flexes to take weight. Anatomical RIGHT trailing heel rises higher, its toe at the last moment of ground contact before toe-off. Left main support; slightly lower body than phase01. Gentle short-step grounded walk with minimal vertical bob; stable upright torso. Hair, skirt, ribbons and tassels react subtly, not wildly. At least one foot supports the ground in every walk. Knees and feet stay on two distinct anatomical tracks, no crossed legs, twisted feet, wide splits, jumping, running, attack, high-knee portrait pose, or large sole facing viewer. Highest visual finish, clean alpha edges without purple/magenta fringe. Maintain N01 body size and head/camera. Small leg-phase change: left forward foot becomes FLAT planted; right trailing heel rises a little more but right toe still touches same rear ground. Ground contact depth stays left shoe farther up and right shoe farther down, never swapped. Small soft left knee bend, torso down only a few pixels.
